prose: Google DeepMind announced Genie 4, a new generation of its world-simulation model. Per The Verge's coverage, Genie 4 is powered by Gemini 3.8 Flash, generates interactive simulations of about two minutes (up from one), adds generated audio, allows real-time edits via natural language, and launches first as a research preview for trusted testers.
highlights: Powered by Gemini 3.8 Flash; adds audio and live prompt edits
Simulations up to ~2 minutes; trusted-tester preview first
Basis: headline plus The Verge; DeepMind blog body unreadable
basis: The DeepMind blog fetch returned a non-text or compressed body, so this entry is based on the headline and the parallel Verge report.
